We propose a close continuous content location framework that is fit for distinguishing and perceiving content from common scenes. The technique depends on associated part calculation through which we can without much of a stretch distinguish the content by disposing of the locales of the picture. This strategy can productively deal with the content on incline pictures and dim districts. We Develop a Windows based Application that can track the content and distinguishes the content over that area. This Project utilizes C#, Windows telephone of 8.1 rendition, OCR. This Approach has preference of being straightforward and open source.

articleTitle: Duality in bipolar triangular fuzzy number quadratic programming problems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: We discuss how to solve bipolar fuzzy quadratic programming problems, where the parameters are bipolar triangular fuzzy numbers, making use of linear ranking functions. Also, we explore some duality properties of bipolar triangular fuzzy number quadratic programming problem (BTFNQPP).

articleTitle: A study on web semantics and services
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Information search and its retrieval methods are the main concern of semantics of web. Web semantics improvesthe information retrieval methods. Various semantics search implementation framework have been seen in the past few years. In semantic search we have to investigate number of pilot projects that focus in on methodologies. Research on semantic search system is continue to find the framework on which semantic framework is formalized. Web services and semantics are used to create the web of distributed machine forproper understanding of data. This paper presents a review on web semantics and search. It described two semantic search systems implementation, based on search query, augment traditional search with relevant data are hated from source. This paper covers the searching and semantic issue ofweb technologyto outline the semantics of the of the search terms for predicting better results.

articleTitle: An approach for tracking of mobile robot with vision sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In mobile robots tracking is an important requirement for real time path planning and obstacle avoidance. Current work proposes an innovative approach which combines feature based object detection, KLT Algorithm based tracking method and Kalman filter based de-noising technique for mobile robot working in real time environment. In the detection phase, the mobile robot is detected using Viola Jones algorithm which extracts detectable feature. Then the position of mobile robot is computed with homography constraints and a region of interest window was set up to accommodate the mobile robot. In the tracking phase, the region of interest window was dealt with using KLT algorithm. The proposed method is of special practical importance in case of specified path tracking as the size of mobile robot image is usually small relative to the captured image of the environment. Thus the analysis of captured image of environment become unnecessary for tracking and thereby reduce computational load. Experiments show that the proposed approach accurately detect and track the mobile robot with error percentage ranging from 0.5% to 8% in different parts of the specified path.

articleTitle: A review on elaborative approach for transmutation of XML entities for recommendation based system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The concept of extensible markup language has evolved through time from SGML to the current XML, with more frequent use of web technologies. In any recommendation system, which is based on user defined rules, and gets its data from Rule ML where data is read and used by xml writer. The concept of enabling fast data processing can be served by SQL. At times it becomes necessary to directly save the data from xml file into SQL format, to enable database processing of data of xml directly. Although multiple ways existed for this task, but this paper is an effort to recognize the entities of xml file use it in tree structure and then use that grilled data for the purpose of data in SQL.

articleTitle: Colour image retrieval based on structural equation model and orthogonality
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel technique for colour image retrieval, based on Statistical analysis, such as Correlation analysis, Structural Equation model. The correlation analysis, which computes the association among the colours, such as Red, Green, and Blue, on region-wise. The obtained correlation coefficient on colour features is tested whether it is significant or not. If it is significant, then it is inferred that the query and target images are same or similar; otherwise it is assumed that the two images are different. The Structural Equation model plays a significant role in fusing the features at low-level features. Thus, in this paper, we have made an attempt to combine the features of various parts of the query image, and then it compares with the features of the target image in the feature database using Structural Equation model. In order to measure the performance of the proposed technique, mean average precision is employed in terms of precision and recall. The obtained results are comparable with the existing methods.

articleTitle: A comparison of compressive sensing application for image denoising with wavelet denoising
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Compressive Sensing is an effective method which allows us to sample below Nyquist rate and thus store less information, thereby saving space. The recovery of the signal from the compressed measurements is done efficiently by means of optimization algorithms. This paper employs the convex optimisation algorithm for reconstruction, which is implemented using the CVX package. This paper also deals with denoising of signals and images using different algorithms used for compressive sensing based denoising namely direct L1, joint L1 and separation based method and discovers the range of signal to noise ratio in which each algorithm is applicable. Compressive sensing based method of denoising proved to be a more effective method than the existing method of wavelet based denoising. The performance comparison of wavelet and compressive sensing based method are done using the parameters signal to noise ratio and mean square error. Denoising finds application in Medical Image analysis, which will enable us to recover the original image after removing the noise caused due to various disturbances. Denosing finds application in Radio Astronomy, in which it enables us to obtain the spatial information without the effect of back ground radiation.

articleTitle: Approaches to gene expression classification using knowledge discovery techniques: A taxonomy and systematic literature review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: A gene expression analysis has received a lot of interest from researchers operational in the bioinformatics fields. The expansion of bioinformatics has made it possible to study the microarray datasets straight as an alternative of to be dependent on intricate biological experiments. Usually microarray dataset's nature is to have less number of samples and large number of genes. The former referred as number of rows and later is referred as number of columns in regular transactional datasets. Inferring these microarray data residues a demanding problem and stay as forefront research part for biomedical researchers in the recent years. Emerging technologies of knowledge discovery and algorithms are being applied on gene expression to find out genomic information most related to a diversity of phenotypes. On the other hand, numerous limitations obstruct biologists from identifying and understanding important patterns, from classifying the phenotype of disease, they also struggle to realize the allegations of a particular outcome. This paper aims on a comparative study of Gene Expression Classification techniques which can classify the phenotype of diseases. In this paper, we propose an effective solution that presents concise mining results by applying classification algorithms on gene expression datasets.

articleTitle: Crop planning optimization with social spider optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Crop planning is a Multi-objective optimization problem, also called as NP-Hard Problem. The crop planning problem has many factors, in that some can be optimized and some cannot be optimized. The main aim of the crop planning is to improve the profit and productivity with the low input cost and resources. Objective of this paper is, to maximize the agricultural profit for improving the economic status of farmers and optimize the land utilization by minimizing the land wastage (unused land). The Social Spider Algorithm is used to solve the problem. This algorithm gives an optimal solution to the crop planning problem.

articleTitle: Grey Immune: Security in hybrid cloud
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: All the general Cryptography Algorithms are used to make a cloud system more secure. While they do this task quiet efficiently the clients have to trust the cloud providing service for the security of their data. This dependency reduces the use of a cloud system by the clients who have some critical data to be stored. Grey Immune: Security in Hybrid Cloud is basically a third-party authenticator which rectifies this issue. It uses Elliptical ElGamal Encryption Cryptography (EEEC) for encryption and decryption of the data. Whenever a user needs to upload a file it goes via Grey Immune to the server. The digital signature of the file is maintained and is never tampered, unless the authorized user makes changes in the file. When a user has to download the file, he is first authenticated by Grey Immune before granting access to the file. After that the file is decrypted and given to the user. Once the file is decrypted and given to the user the existing digital signature will be destroyed and a new signature will be generated when the file is uploaded again.

articleTitle: Evaluation of address resolution protocol and essential security issues
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: An internet consists of various types of network and connecting devices like router. A packets starts from the source host, passes through many physical network and finally, reaches the destination host. At the network level, the routers are recognized by their IP address. The main limitation of ARP is traffic jam in nodes due to unless point to point communication. ARP Request is point to point communication which packet doesn't contain hardware address of receiver per as my research when a packet extend it content and include the hardware address it can maintain point to point communication with the nodes(machine). ARP Reply includes point to point in network, as my research the packet reply at broadcasting to every node which copy the sender and receiver hardware address. As per research, the COUNT helps to check the no of nodes viewed the packet.

articleTitle: Modified RS encoder architecture with reduced critical path delay for high speed data communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this digital era the cause of the current trend for wireless applications is the improved data rate for multifarious applications of communication. But during communication, the data might be distorted due to impairments of channels. Decrease in errors because of distorted channels becomes significant. RS encoder with reduced critical path delay for data storage communication is presented in this paper. With minimum delay data can be transmitted at high rate on using pipelining and parallelizing techniques. By transforming the LFSR into the form of an Infinite Impulse Response (IIR) filter the increased delay in the basic LFSR based Reed Solomon encoder is eradicated. The projected architecture results in high speed and reduced critical path with less hardware overhead. A case representing the parallel and pipelined design of an encoder is given for (15, 11) RS code. The proposed design produces a delay of 2.39nS at the rate of 418.59MHz.

articleTitle: Survey on exploring randomness for mobility models of the airborne network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this paper, we formally introduced an architecture of routing in the exist IP-based Airborne Network (AN). Its hierarchical network with number of heterogeneous nodes and waveforms, owing to the extremely dynamic nature and constraints of bandwidth. So, new technologies are required to distribute a reliable network with identical levels of mission to hold up in terrestrial networks. And mobility models serve as the typing below ground level to evaluating and designing the airborne networks. Cause of the performance impact of mobility models on the networks, the model of mobility must be pragmatic capture the airborne network allocation.

articleTitle: Grouping approach using Strength of Device Synergy (GASDS) in WSN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Cluster formation is the major task in any field. And also identifying the connectivity failures in the network and restoring the same has been a significant issue in the field of wireless sensor networks. For this to happen, a better solution is to be considered. Till now there has been many researches going on for enhancing the performance of the wireless networks especially WSNs. Different heuristic approaches have been proposed for resolving such issues. Such techniques work effectively under a condition that the sensor nodes should have a specific mobility pattern. But this is not the case at all the places, for example, remote monitoring at unreachable locations, military battle fields, nuclear pollution environment monitoring and so on. To handle such situations, a new approach called Grouping Approach using Strength of Device Synergy (GASDS) based on Firefly Algorithm is proposed. Throughput and packet loss ratio are the two major parameters considered in the simulation.

articleTitle: Group cohesiveness among quality circle — Factor reduction using eigen values
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Small Group Activity (SGA) called as Quality Circles is formed by cluster of employees from the same work area who meet voluntarily play a major role in solving work related problems. Hence group cohesiveness among the quality circle members is very essential which impact productivity and performance. Thus the current study identifies the key factors determining the attributes for group cohesiveness of employees using factor analysis and four factors namely i) Relationship and interaction with group members ii) Members are honest and straightforward iii) Personal goal attainment and iv) Level of trust were extracted from the Factor analysis. Employees perception towards advantages of being a part of team has been studied and analytical skill has been considered as the best advantage. The desirable skills set to enhance group cohesiveness of employees as perceived by the employees are studied. This group cohesiveness promotion and SGA and accomplishing performance is a style of management that puts great importance on involvement of employee and actively encourages participation and commitment. So this study deals with Small Group Activity (SGA) in Lucas-TVS, Chennai which is a global Auto industry promoting innovative products and values to customer by employee involvement and commitment, which has been promoted by Small Group Activity, has been selected as a study unit for the current study.

articleTitle: Smart snoezelen bubble tube for mentally challenged and learning disability
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In recent years there has been a rapid increase in use of therapies for mentally challenged. This paper describes the use of a Snoezelen bubble tube. The simplest way to cope up with the mental handicapped is to respond according to their actions. In order to bring positive development in them, one of the therapy is using snoezelen bubble tube, in this paper we like to add some more new features to Snoezelen bubble tube for the betterment of people suffering with learning disabilities and mentally challenged.

Author Keywords: OMAP L-138 DSP Board i.e. we are using this board to give the output lights according to the situation

articleTitle: Digital signatures for secure communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The aim of the project is to make an application which helps people to communicate on a locally developed insecure communication protocols like, college libraries, small scale industries etc. While providing security for such communication protocols. This is achieved by using one of the most popular RSA encryption technique with key size selection for users. A database is also made for storing the users as well as the passwords of said users. The message is send from one computer to the other using socket programming and sever client model. This application is made on java platform for easy portability on any system. This developed utility can easily configure and install on any developed communication protocol for privacy as well as security.

articleTitle: Design methodology to check the quality of the image in a mobile environment — State of the art
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper presents a methodology to measure the level of focus and to identify the areas of the skin with high levels of Specular-reflection that are uploaded to the BTBP mobile application for skin analysis. Measuring this information makes it possible to give the user feedback on the quality of their image capture, and how to improve future captures. Specular-Reflection is excessive reflection from the skin's surface has a detrimental effect on skin analysis. In order to avoid such problems we need to identify areas of intense Specular-Reflection and eliminate those areas from analysis. The concept used here is histogram analysis. Each time an image is captured, the camera's auto-focus is used to try and achieve optimal focus. Occasionally this can fail and result in an image that is out-of-focus and therefore undesirable In order to reject these images, focus level quantification is necessary. Referring to the edge information of the objects in the image, calculate the level of sharpness in the image. Filtering and image enhancement concepts will be used for this implementation. This will be implemented using the C# platform and will utilize the Open CV library. This includes learning about Image declarations, image data reading and assigning in C#.

articleTitle: A review on technical-economic aspects of grid connected hybrid renewable energy power system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In the current years, little scale control era has been perceived as an appropriate choice for vitality access in disengaged country regions because of uneconomical network extension. It is very obvious that charge of rustic regions can enhance the standard of instruction, wellbeing conditions, living and enabling the young of the close-by population. Electrification of these towns of remote slopes utilizing sustainable power source assets in off-framework mode is a feasible choice contrasted with uneconomical grid extension. They introduce ponder contains the usage of single innovation based framework, for example, little hydro, biomass, biogas, sun oriented and little breeze turbines etc. The goal of the investigation is to limit the aggregate cost of era and cost of vitality utilizing hereditary algorithm (GA) based approach.

articleTitle: Analysis of risk in software process models
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Risk free software development is one of the most anticipated development methodologies in the current world of Information Technology. This not only brings down the possibilities of failure in the project, also ensures the customer satisfaction. Hence, it is mandatory to analyze the potentials of disasters in a project from various aspects with mitigation ready in hand so that the impact of the adversity can be brought down. This paper focuses on one such aspect of investigating risks where the risk is analyzed in the following software development process methodologies that are Waterfall Model, Incremental Model, Spiral Model and RUP Model. Analyzed risks definitely bring up the success rate as the parameters which affects success of project such as CTP2 (Cost, Time, People, and Process) can be meticulously looked into. Hence, project managers can make judicious judgment regarding risk management tactics and ensure attainment of project success.

articleTitle: A novel approach for clustering hindi tweets
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Social media online platforms have critical data. The information accessible on the Social Networking platforms isn't just enormous in volume, yet in addition in assorted variety of subject and quality. Such factors make it infeasible to productively rummage helpful data from it. Twitter is an online news and person to person communication benefit where user posts and co-operate with messages, “Tweets”. Tweets on Twitter contains diverse news and events. Thus, this paper intends to order these posts into various classes utilizing WSD (Word Sense Disambiguation) with the goal that the user will have the capacity to get to the class of tweets he needs to search for. For grouping the tweets, we utilize knn (K - Nearest Neighbour) algorithm. Word sense disambiguation is a process of automatically figuring out the intended meaning of such words when used in a sentence. For this purpose, we used LESK algorithm based on two assumptions. First assumption is, when two words are used in closed proximity in a sentence. Second, if one sense each of the two words can be used to talk of the same topic.

articleTitle: Software reliability models — A comparative study
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Software reliability defined as the probability of failure free operation for a specified period of time in a specified environment. Developing reliable software is one of the most difficult problems facing the reliability is known from customer feedback in the form of defects. A number of software reliability models have evolved since early 1970 to predict software reliability. This paper surveys the evolution of reliability models and purpose an approach in the selection of an appropriate model for different phases of software development lifecycle (SDLC).

articleTitle: Impact of supply chain technologies on sustainable retail operations — A SEM approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The main motive of this research is to find the recognition and practice of Supply chain Technologies by organised retail outlets in the Indian Tier2 city Trichy, Thanjavur and Kumbakonam. Past researchers have found the value of Supply chain technologies on store operations of large retails, in tier1 cities of India but the impact of these practices on Tier2 city was not made as these locations are aiming towards the growth of this sector in the economy of our country. A questionnaire survey based on Likert scales was developed and administered at organized retail outlets in and around Trichy and Thanjavur. A total of 74 valid responses were collected. The collected data was tested using structural equation modelling. This study suggests that implementation of supply chain technologies is fairly related to the retail product pricing and retail operational efficiency. Understanding and application of supply chain technologies are observed with the small retailers. This research implies perceptual analysis measures of a store manager or store operators only. Future studies can expand on this research by analysing the actual data regarding the supply chain management and can predict the actual performance. This article is the initial attempt to study supply chain technologies among the organised retailer in the tier-2 cities of India.

articleTitle: A recent trends and analysis of various techniques of false minutiae removal for fingerprint image
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This In the field of Biometrics, Fingerprint is among the most used and well accepted biometric traits. The fingerprint recognition has higher accuracy, reliability and simplicity as compared to other biometric traits. Fingerprint is obtained by a live scan or an offline scan by the biometric System. These systems differentiate stored fingerprint with the obtained fingerprint by comparing their minutiae points. Minutiae are major features of a fingerprint, arising from local ridge discontinuities: ridge endings and ridge bifurcations. Therefore, extraction of true minutiae points in addition to the removal of false minutiae by enhancement of fingerprint image is important. Such research challenge is impacting on complete applications based on fingerprint systems. The scope this paper is presents a survey on different methods of enhancing of fingerprint image as well as the different methods for detection and removal of false minutiae from the fingerprint image.

articleTitle: A study on electronic stock trading behaviour — A structural equation model (SEM) approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Equity markets have been characterised by increasing volatility and fluctuations. In recent years, cases of market inefficiency in the form of market anomalies and irrational investor behavior have been more frequent. The purpose of this study was to examine the level of investor awareness and perceived risk attitudes affects the stock market investor behavior. The research study is based on the primary data for a period of 2016-2017. This research chooses a sample of 200 investors as the subject and collects data by simple random sampling. Data was obtained through survey questionnaires. The data was analyzed using SPSS 19.0 and SEM-PLS software. The result obtained was analyzed. Investor awareness was found to significantly predict investor behavior and perceived risk attitudes The results on the relationship indicated that the investor awareness and perceived risk attitudes are positively correlated to stock market investor behaviour. In light of the above findings, various recommendations are suggested on how investors can make use of available information to make objective investment decisions. This will help in encouraging potential investors to invest in the securities market.

articleTitle: Quick response codes decodability improvements using error correction levels
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In today's era usage of QR Codes (Quick Responsive codes) has become very common. The problem arise with the poor quality of QR Code. Due to this its decodability must need to be focused. As the reproduction (i.e. printing process) of QR Code for different image formats may include compressions and transformations, there are the major cause of distortion and noise which majorly affects the quality of the QR Codes and so apparently the decodability of QR Codes will get affected. In this approach we have discussed about the vital point of QR Codes called Error Correction levels L, M, Q, and H. For the different image formats (such as bmp, jpg, png etc.) the MSE (Mean Squared Error) and PSNR (Peak Signal Noise Ratio) values will be calculated to carry out better quality for the QR Codes by reducing the distortion and noise. The improvement will help to give better results to make QR Codes more useful in every way such as, for commercial purpose, for the education purpose, to store the information, to store the URL.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of SSSC for power oscillations damping using fire-fly algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper analyze the performance of a series FACT controller at different location of a power system. In a multi-machine system subjected to a three phase fault, the Static Synchronous Series Compensator connected at area 1, area 2 and in the mid-point of transmission line is analyzed. Proportional+Integral+Derivative controller is used to control the reference input signal to the Static Synchronous Series Compensator whose parameters are optimized using firefly algorithm. The referred compensator along with its controller is used to enhance and damp out the transmitted power. The proposed work shows that the Static Synchronous Series Compensator connected at the area 1, near the machine 1 performs better in terms of percentage of maximum overshoot and settling time for a three phase fault whereas it is independent of the location for a single phase fault.

articleTitle: Register control system for offset printing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: A printing press is a mechanical gadget for applying weight to an inked surface resting upon a medium, (for example, paper or fabric), accordingly exchanging a picture. The frameworks included were first amassed in Germany by the goldsmith Johannes Gutenberg in the mid-fifteenth century. Johannes Gutenberg is typically referred to as the designer of the printing press. In fact, the German goldsmith's fifteenth century commitment to the innovation was progressive empowering the large scale manufacturing of books and the quick scattering of learning all through Europe. Feb 25, 2014The printing press is viewed as a standout amongst the most huge developments of the medieval times since, such as nothing some time recently, it empowered the quick stream of data and prompt the spread of new thoughts.

articleTitle: LibX — An automated bibliotheca
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Classification in machine learning and recommendation models has been replicated by many studies through different algorithms. The paper discusses why naïve Bayesian is one of the most preferred algorithms of implementation in machine learning. It also discusses its application for library recommendation system. The paper talks about algorithmic model and proposed system in detail. Hybrid recommendation systems are discussed with other approaches like collaborative and content based filtering. The paper also provides comparative advantages and details of Naïve Bayes algorithm. The paper also provides comparative advantages and details of Naïve Bayes algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive feedback equalization technique with tunability using microwind tool
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Ultralow-power subthreshold logic circuits are becoming prominent in embedded applications with limited energy budgets. Minimum energy consumption of digital logic circuits can be obtained by operating in the subthreshold regime. A tunable adaptive feedback equalizer circuit that can be used with a sequential digital logic to mitigate the process variation effects and reduce the dominant leakage energy component in the subthreshold digital logic circuits. Subthreshold is the current between the source and drain of a MOSFET when the transistor is in subthreshold region, or weak-inversion region, that is, for gate-to source voltages below the threshold voltage. By using single feedback circuit, to reduce the power consumption &energy consumption.

articleTitle: Data hiding in encrypted images using transpose based reserving room before encryption & discrete wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Data hiding in encrypted images has the advantage of good privacy and security. This technique will be used for hiding a secret image inside a cover image using secret keys. In this paper, the Discrete Wavelet Transform method is used. (DWT) is any wavelet transform which is discretely sampled which captures both frequency and location information. The Discrete Wavelet Transform gives the excellent peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) and less computation time The main advantage of using DWT transform is that the whole image would be processed as a single unit. It shows high robustness. The embedded secret image can be extracted with high visual quality. The patch can be used instead of pixels which result in large hiding room. Thus sparse coding is used, which is an approximation solution; the leading residual errors are encoded and self-embedded within the cover image. Hence no loss of data is observed because the learned dictionary is also embedded into the encrypted image and a large vacated room can be achieved and thus the data hider can embed more secret messages in the encrypted image. The PSNR of the method has been increased by 9.18 percent approximately.

articleTitle: Computational analysis of hybrid high efficiency video encoders
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: With the evolution of technology, it has become necessary to make transmission more competitive. By using new state-of-the-art coding technology HEVC (H.265), one will be able to broadcast more programs, using HDTV instead of SD, accompanied by further improvements in audio and data services. Moreover, enhancement in broadcasting video-on-demand services and live streaming is possible with faster rate and low cost. The aim of this new standard is to transmit high resolution video in low bandwidth. This article focus on performance comparison between HEVC and H.264 video compression standards in terms of encoding time and PSNR and bit rate. Four different test sequences in random access configuration were used for HM software(HEVC test model) and same configuration was maintained for JM reference software (H.264 test model) as well in order to carry out the experimentation. It was been observed that HM obtains more compression ratio than JM in turn it can deliver the video at half the bit rate as compared to earlier codec standard JM but this is achieved at the cost of increase in encoding time.

articleTitle: Single image super resolution: An efficient approach using auto-learning and filter pooling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Stimulated by recent approaches on internal database driven image super resolution, we propose a super resolution algorithm based on auto learning and filter pooling approach. This paper presents an algorithm where auto-trained high frequency cluster of patches are used to reconstruct a high resolution image. The auto-trained features are extracted using filter pooling approach combining the advantages of Sobel and Gabor filters. The key feature of this approach is preserving features at different frequencies with different orientations using self-similarity to avoid the use of multiple images. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed technique gives better results when compared to existing state-of-the-art internal database methods for image super resolution in terms of quantitative and qualitative performance measures.

articleTitle: Domain based resource information aggregation in computational grid
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Grid Computing is a method of distributed computing to manage and share the networked resources, data domains, storage procedure, processing power across geologically distributed locations. In the computational grid environment, information services are essential to provide information about various computational resources. This information includes configuration of resources, policies, agreement that are managed by both higher level and lower level schedulers. Resource information aggregation schemes are used to reduce the quantity of information exchanged between the networked resources. Through information aggregation, the characteristics of resources are potted and then sent to the scheduling actions. In this paper we are proposing a separate module named RIM (Resource Information Module)for information aggregation in each domain. The experimental results show that the proposed aggregation schemes achieve large information reduction and better resource selection scheme for enabling improved task scheduling decisions.

articleTitle: A study of gender recognition from Iris: A literature survey
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Recent biometrie research has examined the possibility of obtaining attributes such as hair color, age, gender, weight, ethnicity, height, etc. from biometric traits, face, hand geometry, fingerprints and iris. This paper examines detailed study about different process, for each step of predicting gender from iris for achieving better accuracy and authentication. Capturing the iris image in high quality specification camera is used to achieving specific features of iris. Different algorithms and software systems are used to locate the boundaries of an iris image. Mutual Information(MI) is better used to compare other feature in geometry, texture etc. UND_V and GFI datasets are used to get more accuracy in SVM classifier for better gender prediction.

articleTitle: Development of medical imaging X-ray shielding materials based on natural rubber/nano composites-thermal degradation studies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper discusses the development of X-ray shielding materials based on rare earth oxide and natural rubber materials. Medical imaging, as we know is currently using highly toxic lead containing garment for protection from harmful radiations. Both technicians as well as patients are suffering from the ill effects of radiation exposure to a great extent. The current research presented in this paper can be an alternative to the above mentioned problems. Rare earth oxide was used as filler in natural rubber matrix to prepare eco-friendly composites. The samples were analyzed to confirm the particle size, even distribution in matrix phase, mechanical properties and their response to high temperature conditions.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of OQAM based GFDM 5G systems under line of sight fading scenarios
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: As the world is moving towards everywhere and everything connected society, the fifth generation cellular systems is the leading technology to realize this dream. Generalized frequency division multiplexing (GFDM) is one of the physical layer waveform considered for 5G to overcome the deficiencies of the existing OFDM based 4G cellular systems such as Inter Carrier Interference (ICI) and Inter Symbol Interference (ISI). Already GFDM research proved that GFDM using Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) is more flexible and robust compared to the OFDM based LTE systems. In this paper, it is considered the performance of the Offset QAM based GFDM and the analysis of Symbol Error performance under various fading conditions. The performance of GFDM-OQAM system is evaluated for Outdoor fading profiles such as Highway Line of Sight (HLOS), Urban Approaching Line Of Sight (UALOS), and Rural Line of Sight (RLOS).

articleTitle: Analysing cross selling performance-fitting in a regression equation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The study focuses on the cross-selling practices in banking service with respect to employee perception. The study is made to diagnose the present cross-selling practices in banks and to know the issues faced by them for improvement of cross-selling performance. The study was limited to bank employees indulge in cross-selling practices. The number of respondents who were answered were 100 totally. The study provided various details like training, motivation factors, knowledge in cross selling and their effectiveness.

articleTitle: Application to predict chances for occurring COPD from symptoms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Chronic diseases may cause heavy burden on health care resources and disturb the condition of life. Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a kind of important chronic disease, which mainly affects middle-aged or older adults who smoke. Many people don't realize they have it. It takes a long period of time to investigate and difficult to detect in early stages. In this work, we propose a novel approach for early assessment on COPD from symptoms by classifying the data using machine learning techniques. The aim of this work is to predict how much percentages chance for occurring COPD in early stages. Use machine learning technique such as Naive Bayes classifier to create a application interface for persons who have to know their health conditions individually that help to further treatment.

articleTitle: Analysis of the scattering from a ferromagnetic microwire using impedance boundary condition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic scattering of a uniform plane wave from an axially magnetized ferromagnetic microwire in free space is theoretically investigated in this paper using impedance boundary condition. A comparison of the results of proposed analysis is done with the results of normal incidence case of scattering obtained by exact analysis available in the literature in order to find the extent of agreement in the two approaches in terms of the radius of microwire. Impact of the radius and surface impedance of the microwire on the scattered field are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Colour image retrieval based on mean vector and covariance tests
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this paper, statistical test of hypothesis based method is proposed, which retrieves manifold color images such as structured, semi-structured, textured, scaled, and rotated. The proposed method, first, performs preprocessing and then employs the test statistic: test for equality of covariance, and generalized component test. If the query and target images pass the covariance test, then it proceeds to test the mean vectors of the two images; otherwise, the test is dropped. If the query and target images pass both tests, then it is concluded that the images belong to same class. Otherwise, they belong to different class. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated using the image database and its feature database. The images have been collected from various datasets to maintain heterogeneity of the images. The proposed method yields better results.

articleTitle: Interconnected islanded microgrid system using smart frequency bus signaling method with PV integration
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: A microgrid is a practical solution for remote areas where the access to public electric grid is technically or economically unattractive. Islanded dc microgrid contains a number of renewable energy sources, local loads, and energy storage systems (ESS). To avoid the over-charging and over-discharging situations of ESS by keeping SoC of ESS in safe range, a coordinated control strategy should be used in islanded dc microgrids. The main objective of this proposed control strategy is to control the SoC of ESS by controlling the power generated by the RESs as well as controlling loads accordingly their priorities. This smart frequency bus signaling uses line frequency of the microgrid as communication link between power sources and their respective converters the amount of power they need to generate and prioritized loads in order to maintain the ESS state of charge below or equal its maximum allowable limit. Proposed system is simple, efficient and more reliable power control technique as it doesn't rely on external communication links and network distribution. Real-time hardware-in-the-loop results of an islanded microgrid are provided under various simulation conditions to validate the proposed expected control strategy in efficient system implementation.

articleTitle: Assessing the impact of personality and psychological ownership in determining emotional intelligence of information technology(IT) employees using curve fit regression
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: For ages we've been debating about whether or not Emotional intelligence will also be learned. Even EI is contributing 80% of a individuals success we aren't mindful of it. Intelligence(IQ) is a threshold potential for entry degree function. Emotional Intelligence is the sine qua non of management. This the connection between demographic characteristics of the respondents and the extent of emotional intelligence, the influence of Big Five Personality traits towards the level of respondents Emotional Intelligence, the influence of Psychological ownership of respondents towards Emotional Intelligence, the influence of Emotional Intelligence towards job Performance, employees wellbeing and stress tolerance. Performance has been categorized as individual context and Task Oriented.

articleTitle: Survey on developing data acquisition system using ZYNQ architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Design of Data Acquisition (DAQ) system is always remains topic of research and development for custom requirements from the environments. This paper represents exploratory analysis of the various system components and their performance parameters. The baseline performance parameters are power requirement, computing capabilities, interface data rates, miniaturization requirements and others. Based on the baseline performance requirements of DAQ system, major system components are quantified and proposed design has adopted Xilinx Zynq 7000 based System on Chip (SoC) which consists of dual-Cortex A9 CPU and an Artix-7 family Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA). At the end of paper, the design of compact instrument based on Zynq7000 SoC is finalized, which satisfies the functional needs and specifications of data acquisition, storage, processing and communication for high speed data acquisition system in a compact package.

articleTitle: Course outcome assessment tool for objective questions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Coat-oq is a tool for generating and evaluating objective question papers as per the practices of outcome based education. This tool generates objective question papers, by randomly selecting the questions from the question base. This tool is developed by using python along with its layout toolkit pyqt. This tool enforces that the objective questions are designed so as to cover all of the course outcomes that were mentioned in the syllabus.

articleTitle: Wi-Fi band rejection with log periodic antenna using integrated filter method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: To achieve large bandwidth log periodic antennas are effectively useful. To get large bandwidth log periodic antenna should be design carefully with impedance matching. One of the best techniques to get large bandwidth is chebyshev impedance matching in log-periodic antenna. In these paper log-periodic antennas is designed with four arms for the both circular and linear polarization. When the 90<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> phase delay applied between the two dipoles the antenna produce circular polarization. The antenna is operated at 3GHz and produces the band of operation from 2GHz to K/Ka band. But 5.1GHz to 5.8GHz frequency band is occupied for WI-Fi applications according to IEEE 802.11. So it is necessary to eliminate Wi-Fi band between 5.1GHz to 5.8GHz, for that we are using integrating filter method. The proposed log periodic antenna with four arm is designed and simulated by using High Frequency Simulation Software. The antenna parameters such as return loss, VSWR, axial ratio, radiation pattern measured between 2GHZ to K/Ka band.

articleTitle: Fitting a linear regression equation for the impact of employee satisfaction on non-monetory benefits
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In today's scenario it's essential for employee retention and employee productivity. Employees work with commitment and genuineness leads the organization to achieve its goals. The study diagnose that employee satisfaction on non-monetary benefits will lead to run a successful business. The scope of this study is to exhibit that to what extent the employees are very satisfied with non - financial benefits provided by the company. The study was mainly focused on the factors like safety, pick up, drop up, cab supervisor details like his responsibility, politeness and reachability, driver details like his responsibility and grooming, quality services and maintenance, query resolution and emergency preparedness. The reason of this paper is to identify the employee satisfaction on GSO Transport facility provided by the company and to find out the factors which affect the employee satisfaction. The study was measured with the help of questionnaire. Sample of 210 respondents have been collected in the area Chennai. Relationships between responses was assessed and presented using tables and graphs and analysis was done using SPSS. Frequency distribution, Chi - square and regression analysis tools are used for interpreting the results. Result of this paper is employees are fairly motivated through non - monetary benefits.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of an electric driver assist system for rush-hour navigation in dense urban traffic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: We describe an electric driver assist system (EDAS) concept, where a vehicle can autonomously navigate and trail a leading vehicle with minimal human intervention. A DC hub-motor driven control system is designed, modelled and simulated using Simulink. The system designed for rush-hour urban settings with speeds of 0-5 Kmph, maintains about 1m separation from the front vehicle. The system uses inexpensive ultrasonic sensors and a tachometer to estimate distance and speed dynamically. The speed-control algorithm is successfully able to track typical rush-hour vehicular profiles. The EDAS has also been implemented on a model car using an Arduino and Beaglebone with acceptable real-time performance results.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high power factor electronic ballast with buck boost converter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel single stage resonant inverter with high power factor for electronic ballast. The proposed topology has buck boost converter along with power factor correction circuit at the input side. It is designed to operate at discontinuous conduction mode. The lamp power is controlled by adjusting the duty ratio of the active switches of the power factor correction circuit. The circuit operation is analyzed in detail to derive the design equations. Circuit parameters are designed based on design considerations. Finally, prototype electronic ballast for a 40-W fluorescent lamp is built and tested. The efficiency and the performance of the proposed converter are verified by the designed prototype.

articleTitle: Sensor lighting system using microcontroller in energy conservation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper proposes the usage of sun light effectively through an automated pavement lighting system with controller support. The major goal is to make pavement lighting system free from programmed operation so there is no wastage of light. The operation makes utilization of controller, different sensors for detecting brightness, humans and number of vehicles and cluster of Light Emitting Diodes. We utilize solar panel and battery to store sun light and changes into electrical energy that will be utilized for pavement lighting system. Amid daytime, sun light is put away and after that relying on normal light brightening in encompassing the variety of LEDs shine utilizing a similar change over sun light. The input/output of sensors will determine the ON/OFF movement of the LEDS. The microcontroller controls the systems and hence switching action is accurate and over usage of light is eliminated. With this proposed system around 65%-70% power consumption is reduced.

articleTitle: Energy performance of optimally inclined free standing photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper is about a simulation study to analyze the energy performance of optimally inclined free standing photovoltaic system. A 10 kWp crystalline PV plant is proposed with free standing installation type for BRCORP office location. The slope angle and azimuth angle are optimized using the PVGIS simulation tool. The proposed system is simulated in PVGIS tool to account for the energy production from the PV plant. The obtained simulation results were discussed as per monthly, yearly PV energy productions, year to year variability, and total losses. Output variations due to angle of incidence, spectral effects, temperature and low irradiance is also discussed. This work would help the energy investors, researchers, and academicians to understand the solar PV system assessments and feasibilities.

articleTitle: Cross cultural adjustment of financial sectors in UAE — Model fit using regression equation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Cross-cultural adjustment is one of the essential emerging areas that every organization looks into as there exist workforce diversity. The rationale behind the study is that to find out how the difference in Indian and UAE work culture especially in the financial sector. In the study, we have grouped different lifestyle management factors and work adjustment factors as independent variables and endeavour to find a relationship between independent variables and the work culture fit of an individual. Samples of 90 collected data have been analysed through statistical tools such as descriptive analysis, Friedman test, and Regression. The results of the study reveal that the working relationship, organization facilities, easy to adapt and to have the reasonable standard of living is the major factors that influence the work culture in the financial sector in UAE.

articleTitle: A triangular fuzzy number approach to multiobjective vendor selection problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Vendor selection is a multi-criteria decision making problem influenced by multiple performance criteria. In this paper, a multi objective vendor selection problem is addressed through the creation of fuzzy Pareto optimal set and its satisfactory level. Each objective function is transformed into a set of three objective functions. The solution (Simonovic and Verma(2008)) is obtained by using positive and negative ideal solutions and a set of weights, in form of triangular fuzzy number, assigned to the objective functions. The optimization problem has been taken from Yucel and Guneri (2011) to illustrate the methodology. Results show that the degree of satisfaction is 0.5 from the view point of a moderate decision maker.

articleTitle: Flavor detection for milk quality assessment using embedded electronic noses
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: A milk of good quality should have a pleasantly sweet and sanitary flavor with similar after taste. One of the most significant quality parameter is the flavor that determines the suitability of milk. The milk is generally transported longer distances to the urban population around large metropolitan centers. Due to increase of population density, the farms sited close to the cities tend to increase their scale of operations. The flavor un-stability in the milk changes the quality of the milk. In many cases the most common flavor defect of milk is feed flavor. It is hard to assess the milk flavor with human nose system. So it is necessary to develop the nostril system to determine the quality of milk based on the odor and flavor. It was done with the development of the embedded artificial electronic olfactory device called electronic nose and is processed and classified using microcontroller. With the help of this Embedded Electronic Noses (EEN) system, it can be easily determine the suitability of milk for consumption. The different flavors have different voltage values (such that different concentrations of gasses in the milk). This method provides a fast, simple, non-expensive and non-destructive method of milk quality assessment and classification. abstract: Conservation of forest and biodiversity is challenging task in today's environment. Various natural calamities and illegal activities in the forest causes loss of natural resources. articleTitle: Modelling of large scale linear discrete time interval systems using K-means algorithm

abstract: This paper proposes a new method for the reduction of discreet time interval systems based on pattern recognition algorithm.
